title: Griffin v. California
text: forbids either comment by the prosecution on the accused's silence or instructions by the court that such silence is evidence of guilt.
holding: 第五修正案禁止检方就被告行使沉默权作评论，也禁止法府向陪审团指示沉默可作为有罪证据。
notes: Verbatim from the opinion at 380 U.S. at 615. The sentence opens "We take that in its literal sense and hold that the Fifth Amendment ... forbids ..."; the quote begins at "forbids".
